issue.title: Add GPS Unix epoch time to telemetry

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Hi,
I noticed that in the latest releases of PX4 firmware, GPS time has been added as "microseconds since UNIX epoch"; it is available in the mavlink message #340 (UTM_GLOBAL_POSITION).
I thought that, if you have a companion computer that doesn't have a RTC Backup Battery, it could be very useful to get the time from GPS. It can be used also to sync time in a swarm of drones.
